reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: The core is a medium-grained, light to medium grey granitoid / tonalite with abundant whitish patches and mottled grey-green areas. Texture is inequigranular / patchy with a weakly foliated / gneissic fabric visible as irregular, diffuse lighter and darker bands wrapping around the core. Grain size appears medium, typical of a plutonic rock.
description.alteration: Weak to moderate chloritic / epidotic alteration is visible as pale bluish-green to grey-green mottling and patches throughout the core; no strong pervasive alteration is clearly discernible at photo resolution.

anomalies.explanation: A single sub-vertical fracture / break is visible in the upper core piece near the right-hand end and a second fracture is visible in the lower core piece on the left-hand side with a small offset; core appears otherwise continuous in the tray.
